excluded.pattern: multi-variable case analysis / nested induction (e.g. andb_comm, orb b1 b2 = orb b2 b1, de Morgan)
excluded.reason: the translator emits one `apply (<T>_ind motive)` per proof and segments a single level of cases; a second destruct inside a case (needed to decide a goal in two booleans) is not yet generated.

excluded.pattern: induction over an inductive relation (e.g. le_trans, le_n_S via le_ind)
excluded.reason: the eliminator has a dependent motive over the derivation; the translator only builds non-dependent `fun (x:T) => <body>` motives.
